title: Distributor requirements and selling rules
objectives: State certification, registration, commission and marketing rules for all three.
Say why AIF social-media offers are a red flag.
body_md:
Certification: MF NISM V-A; PMS NISM XXI-A; AIF NISM XIX-A (Cat I & II) / XIX-B (Cat III). Registration: MF AMFI (ARN); PMS APMI (APRN); AIF must be a SEBI-registered intermediary route. Commission: MF trail only; PMS trail only; AIF Cat III trail only; Cat I & II up to one-third upfront, rest as trail over the tenure. Marketing: MF public advertising allowed within rules; PMS through registered distributors; AIF private placement only, no public invitation or mass marketing.

|  | MF | PMS | AIF |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Certification | NISM V-A | NISM XXI-A | NISM XIX-A (Cat I & II) / XIX-B (Cat III) |
| Registration | AMFI (ARN) | APMI (APRN) | Must be a SEBI-registered intermediary route |
| Commission | Trail only | Trail only | Cat III: trail only; Cat I & II: up to one-third upfront, rest as trail over the tenure |
| Marketing | Public advertising allowed within rules | Through registered distributors | Private placement only; no public invitation or mass marketing |
example: An “AIF with 18% fixed returns” advertised on social media: AIFs can't be publicly advertised or promise returns — treat it as a red flag and verify registration.
say: Sell AIFs only through private placement, to eligible investors.
Disclose commission and the direct option.
never: Sell a product you're not certified for.

check.q: Which NISM certification is needed to distribute Category III AIFs?
check.why: XIX-B. XIX-A is for Category I & II.

check.q: How is distributor commission paid on Category III AIFs?
check.why: Trail only. No upfront fee for Cat III; Cat I & II may pay up to one-third upfront.

check.q: A social media post offers an “AIF with fixed 18% returns”. What is it?
o: A red flag: AIFs cannot be publicly advertised or promise returns
check.why: AIFs cannot be publicly advertised or promise returns.
